verdict.rationale: Linear documents a public GraphQL API that works with personal API keys, plus a typed TypeScript SDK, so scripts and CI jobs can drive it without the UI. It also publishes rate limits for API-key use and offers scheduled or event-triggered agent Loops for in-product automation. There is no official CLI, GitHub Action, or CI-specific guidance, so the headless-in-CI case rests on generic API access. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration (e.g., a GitHub Action), documented headless/CI workflow guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
